name: 范書愷
objective:
針對學生之學習研究心得報告，集體討論，以訓練學生研究之能力。

Regarding students' learning research experience reports, conduct group discussions to train students' research abilities."
課程進度(1-16週):
每週次以學生研讀學術論文進行專題報告為主。

Each week focuses primarily on students reading academic papers and giving topical presentations.
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          **  SOTA paper reading
**  Paper Presentation Sharing
**  SOTA research progress learning via watching internet video, followed by group discussion
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          **  Paper presentation
**  Written report submission
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          It counts a bonus point.

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
